_comment: Planned --detail payload for node 'listAadGroups1' (uipath.connector.uipath-microsoft-azureactivedirectory.list-groups). _configureCommand: uip maestro flow node configure CeqlWhereTest.flow listAadGroups1 --detail '{...see fields below...}' --output json
_notes: connector key confirmed from registry: uipath-microsoft-azureactivedirectory
filter uses FilterBuilder CEQL tree — the CLI compiles this to queryParameters.where='displayName = \'active\'' and also saves savedFilterTrees.where for Studio Web round-trip
connectionId and folderKey must be filled from: uip is connections list uipath-microsoft-azureactivedirectory --all-folders --output json
node configure MUST run before flow validate will fully pass (inputs.detail is currently empty)
